lead.t:
Lipid-lowering drugs
Statins (e.g. simvastatin) are the first-choice drugs for this indication
because they are the most effective at reducing LDL cholesterol and
have been shown unequivocally to reduce cardiovascular events in
large-scale randomised controlled trials.

src.t: Devendra K. Gupta, Krishna M. Goel - Hutchison’s Paediatrics. chdhe-Jaypee Brothers (2012)
